description: Fetch annual international trade-in-services data through the combined EB classification; each row identifies its actual classification edition. Same bilateral structure as goods trade: returns flow value in USD, period, and reporter/partner/category metadata for each row. Use comtrade_list_service_categories to find the right service code before querying. Preview makes one paced request per served period, capped at 500 records per request. Services coverage is more limited than goods trade.

partner_code.description: M49 partner code. Use 0 for all partners combined. Omit for a disaggregated by-partner breakdown.

period.description: Annual periods YYYY. Serves the first 12 and discloses the remainder; input ceiling 120. Preview makes one paced request per period.

reporter_code.description: M49 numeric code of the reporting country (0–999).

service_code.description: EB service category code (e.g. "SA" for manufacturing services or "3" for transport). Use comtrade_list_service_categories to find available codes. Omit to get totals across all service categories.

name: comtrade_get_services_trade

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_reporter_filter`: Reporter omission lacks an explicit partner. `upstream_validation`: UN Comtrade rejects the query dimensions. `invalid_upstream_response`: UN Comtrade returns malformed services data. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Recovery hint when no records are returned.

items.description: A single services trade flow record.

classificationCode.description: Actual services classification edition on the returned row.

isReported.description: True if directly reported; false if estimated.

referenceNotice.description: Reference descriptions unavailable; codes and values retained.

totalCount.description: Sum of upstream response counts before local filtering; not a full match count when capped.

truncated.description: True when any preview response reached 500 and may be incomplete.

truncationHint.description: Query narrowing and authenticated access guidance when possibly incomplete.

unservedPeriods.description: Periods beyond the 12-period work cap; query them separately.

title: Get Services Trade Data
